<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macro Outlook:</strong> Moody’s has upgraded India’s FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7%, though it cautioned that elevated crude oil prices and El Niño remain potential inflationary risks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy:</strong> Market participants are closely monitoring the US Federal Reserve, with rising inflation concerns and climbing bond yields fueling speculation about potential rate hikes that could influence the RBI’s upcoming policy stance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and Commodities:</strong> The Indian rupee recovered 16 paise to 95.73 against the US dollar, supported by a decline in Brent crude oil prices which has also eased broader inflationary pressures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
